rationale: Both Sandeep and Ankit are focused on LLM tooling and ML infrastructure, with complementary expertise—Sandeep brings deep systems engineering experience from xAI with infrastructure skills (Kubernetes, AWS, PyTorch), while Ankit is building at Clio AI as a founder-researcher with full-stack capabilities. They could explore how Sandeep's inference optimization work and distributed computing expertise could strengthen Clio AI's technical foundation.
intro_message: Sandeep, meet Ankit Maloo—he's building Clio AI on LLM tooling and could benefit from your infrastructure expertise in inference optimization and large-scale systems.
